stops.note: meaning "a drop" or "point", a symbolic dot
the decorative forehead mark worn by South Asian women
recorded as early as 1872 by B. H. Baden-Powell, a British civil servant in the Punjab; traditionally a marker of married Hindu women, now also worn as fashion
stops.meaning: a decorative dot worn on the forehead

current_meaning: a decorative mark, often a dot, worn on the forehead, especially by South Asian women
